summary: Extends RSVP-TE to bind two point-to-point unidirectional label switched paths into one associated bidirectional path. It defines new Association Types for the ASSOCIATION and Extended ASSOCIATION objects, supporting two-way traffic where each direction may follow a different route.

eli5.summary: Two one-way streets that together act like a two-way road. This gives them a shared label so the network knows they belong to the same trip.
